Skatteverket: Belopp och procent – inkomstår 2026 (Begravningsavgift; Kyrkoavgift)

rows.section: Norrbotten County (Norrbottens län): averages 2026
rows.label: Average total municipal tax rate in the county (municipality + region)
rows.basis: Taxable earned income
rows.note: Averages from SCB. The church fee is set by each parish; the county average is shown. State income tax (20% above SEK 643,000) comes on top nationally.
